title: WaveCloseParams
description: Parameters for the wave.close agent tool: end one of your workers. It stops the worker's process; whatever it had not finished is not finished. Reach for it when the work is done or is no longer wanted — not to retry, since a closed worker does not come back and starting another is a separate act. You can only close workers your own session started, and only while nocx still says you may.

worker.description: The worker's id, exactly as wave.spawn returned it or wave.holdings listed it.

result.title: WaveCloseResult
result.description: What was asked of the worker. Note what this does NOT say: it does not say the worker has finished. Ending its process is a request, and how it ended is a fact nocx observes for itself — ask wave.holdings for that.

id.description: The worker that was asked to end.

ended.description: True when nocx asked the worker's process to stop, and true as well when it had already finished before you asked — tidying up should not have to win a race.
